# Youniss

> Applied AI engineer. I work on retrieval that has to stay current and on
> agents whose behaviour has to be checkable rather than trusted. BSc in
> Artificial Intelligence from JKU, with a thesis on audio-text retrieval that
> reports a negative result. I publish the things that did not work as well as
> the things that did, I make videos explaining machine learning, and I ship
> small tools end to end rather than stopping at a notebook.

This site is static HTML. No page needs JavaScript to be read, nothing is
behind a paywall or a login, and there is no tracking of any kind.
Content is CC BY 4.0; code is MIT.

## Pages

- [Projects](https://youniss.dev/projects/): the full archive, filterable by category and stack
- [Library](https://youniss.dev/library/): writing, papers and videos in one list, newest first
- [Writing](https://youniss.dev/writing/): posts only
- [Papers](https://youniss.dev/papers/): publications only, each with an abstract and BibTeX
- [Videos](https://youniss.dev/videos/): the video archive
- [Now](https://youniss.dev/now/): what I am working on, studying and building at the moment
- [Uses](https://youniss.dev/uses/): the languages, frameworks and infrastructure I actually work in
- [Contact](https://youniss.dev/contact/): a form, which is the only reliable channel

## Papers

- [Enhancing Language-Based Audio Retrieval with Partial Fine-Tuning and Attention Pooling](https://youniss.dev/papers/dcase-2025-language-based-audio-retrieval/): DCASE 2025 Challenge — Technical Report (Task 6: Language-Based Audio Retrieval), 2025.
- [LLM-Based Recommender Systems](https://youniss.dev/papers/llm-based-recommender-systems/): JKU Linz — Seminar Paper, 2025.
- [Vision-Mediated Learning for Audio–Text Retrieval](https://youniss.dev/papers/vision-mediated-audio-text-retrieval/): Bachelor Thesis — Institute of Computational Perception, Johannes Kepler University Linz, 2025.

## Projects

- [nanoBeard](https://youniss.dev/projects/nanobeard/): A small pirate-themed GPT trained from scratch on a piratized TinyStories corpus and then SFT-tuned, with a versioned training codebase.
- [PaperNavigator](https://youniss.dev/projects/papernavigator/): Academic paper discovery tool that profiles a research question, snowballs through citations, filters with an LLM and generates a report.
- [TempBench, temporal reasoning in audio language models](https://youniss.dev/projects/tempbench-temporal-lalm-reasoning-benchmark/): Benchmark of seven synthetic task families testing whether audio-language models handle trivial questions about event order and timing.
- [Tython](https://youniss.dev/projects/tython/): A statically typed, deliberately opinionated toy language with its own parser, standard library and Python interop.
- [DISCO](https://youniss.dev/projects/disco-v01/): CLIP-based classifier for detecting implicit suggestive imagery, trained on a hand-labelled fashion dataset and published on Hugging Face.
- [Embed2Image contrastive retrieval](https://youniss.dev/projects/embed2image-contrastive-retrieval/): Audio-text retrieval experiments on Clotho comparing a PaSST+RoBERTa baseline against a pseudo-image ViT encoder head.
- [Falcon-Twig](https://youniss.dev/projects/falcon-twig/): Fine-tuning run for Falcon H1 7B on tool calling that underperformed the base instruct model, written up in a post.
- [Gaussian elimination game](https://youniss.dev/projects/gaussian-elimination-game/): Browser exercise that walks through Gaussian elimination one row operation at a time.
- [JKU Exam Practice](https://youniss.dev/projects/jku-exam-practice/): Web app where JKU students add, share and drill each other's exam questions, with LaTeX rendering, timed tests and an XP indicator.
- [Privacy Journal](https://youniss.dev/projects/privacy-journal-web/): Journalling app that stores every entry in the user's own private GitHub repo, with Whisper voice-note transcription.
- [Shopify Search](https://youniss.dev/projects/shopify-search/): Product discovery engine that scrapes thousands of Shopify storefronts and serves embedding-based search over the aggregate catalogue.
- [Tool Calling SFT Mix](https://youniss.dev/projects/tool-calling-mix/): Supervised fine-tuning dataset for tool use, unifying several public tool-calling corpora plus deliberate no-call examples under one schema.
- [p5.js Sketches](https://youniss.dev/projects/p5-projects/): Collection of generative and simulation sketches, particle systems, Mandelbrot set, Maurer roses, self-avoiding walks, cloth waves.

## Writing

- [Falcon Twig: a tool-calling fine-tune that lost to the base model](https://youniss.dev/writing/falcon-twig/): I fine-tuned Falcon-H1-7B-Instruct on a tool-calling mix with QLoRA and re-ran BFCL. It scored 24.50% live accuracy against the base model's 67.21%.
- [Solve sudoku using propositional Logic](https://youniss.dev/writing/solve-sudoku-with-logic/): Encoding a 4x4 Sudoku as a propositional formula: cell, row, column and 2x2 constraints, then letting the limboole SAT checker solve it.
- [React für Nicht-Web-Entwickler](https://youniss.dev/writing/grundlagen-react/) (German): Workshop-Einstieg in React für Entwickler ohne Web-Hintergrund: von der statischen Webseite über Web 2.0 und Single-Page-Applications bis zum ersten React-Projekt.
